cards.title: Format a typed score
cards.explanation: Call ScoreLabel.format("Ada", 5) to produce Ada: 5 (pass). String.formatted requires Java 15+; the playground targets Java 21.

cards.title: Total only even values
cards.explanation: Skips odd numbers and handles an empty array without a special case.

cards.title: Clamp a value with a reusable method
cards.explanation: Clamp.apply(12, 0, 10) returns 10. Invalid bounds fail explicitly.

cards.title: Encapsulate a visit counter
cards.explanation: Create a counter and call visit twice; report observes state on that same object.

cards.title: Inject a greeting strategy
cards.explanation: Pass name -> "Hello, " + name as the greeting strategy; no mutable global configuration is needed.

cards.title: Validate an immutable order value
cards.explanation: Use a compact constructor to reject invalid order values once at the boundary.

cards.title: Copy values from a covariant source
cards.explanation: Copy integers into a mutable List<Number> without casting or changing the source.

cards.title: Count words in insertion order
cards.explanation: Counts exact case-sensitive words and retains their first-seen order. Empty input yields an empty map.

cards.title: Filter and sort positive values
cards.explanation: Produces a sorted positive-only list without changing the input.

cards.title: Group order quantities by name
cards.explanation: Returns name-sorted totals, so duplicate tea lines are combined and output is deterministic.

cards.title: Normalize an optional display name
cards.explanation: Handles null, whitespace-only names and surrounding spaces without dereferencing null.

cards.title: Report a malformed quantity with its cause
cards.explanation: Separates malformed input from a well-formed nonpositive quantity, preserving the parse cause.

cards.title: Close a line reader on success and failure
cards.explanation: Reads only the first line and closes the reader even if reading fails. An empty file returns null; missing files throw IOException.

cards.title: Write and read a UTF-8 report
cards.explanation: The caller supplies a disposable directory. This overwrites only report.txt in that directory and preserves non-ASCII text.

cards.title: Compose an asynchronous calculation
cards.explanation: The caller owns the executor. Use a managed executor and observe both the result and failure rather than starting unobserved work.

cards.title: Collect worker results and close the executor
cards.explanation: Both submitted results are observed. Closing the executor waits for termination; a get timeout alone does not stop a task.

cards.title: Sort names using a static import
cards.explanation: Place SortedNames.java under your own package directory and add its matching package line before the imports. The compiler harness supplies the playground package.

cards.title: Assert values and failures with JUnit Jupiter
cards.explanation: Requires the Clamp method from the methods example, in the same package, and JUnit Jupiter 5.13.4 on the test classpath. Run with Maven test.

cards.title: Test clamp boundaries with parameterized cases
cards.explanation: Requires Clamp from the methods example and JUnit Jupiter/params 5.13.4; every row becomes a separate test invocation.

cards.title: Round-trip an order through Jackson JSON
cards.explanation: Uses jackson-databind 2.19.4, pinned by the playground. No network request occurs; JSON serialization does not by itself validate business rules.

cards.title: Handle malformed or unexpected JSON
cards.explanation: Rejects malformed JSON, unknown fields and invalid business values. Do not return raw parser details to an HTTP client.

cards.title: Serve and create a validated JSON order
cards.explanation: Use Spring Boot 3.5.7 with web and validation starters. Run with the playground application below the same package. This illustrative endpoint echoes orders; it has no persistence. Add the separate ApiErrors advice for predictable failures.

cards.title: Validate order values before a service call
cards.explanation: Uses starter-validation/Hibernate Validator in the pinned Boot playground. The factory is closed here; application services should reuse a managed Validator instead of constructing a factory per request.

cards.title: Return stable JSON errors for invalid requests
cards.explanation: Pair with OrderController and component scanning. Quantity zero/blank names and malformed JSON return 400; the reserved name returns 409. No broad Exception handler masks unexpected failures.

cards.title: Test JSON requests without a listening server
cards.explanation: Requires PlaygroundApplication, OrderController and ApiErrors from this playground in the same package, plus spring-boot-starter-test. Tests use real Spring/Jackson/validation without opening a port.
